regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours these days. The above name - Carson Stone - is the name we were trying to think of this p.m. coming home from the doctor's. It was he from whom I received the remarkable letter that I have been anxious a- bout, and that has been on my mind and on my conscience for quite a time. Let me first till you something about him so that I have cause enough for anyone to be ashamed of himself, to say the very least. ... World War II was fiercely on and the crazy nazies seem to have suc- ceeded in landing quite some of their assiciates for employment in Detroit, especially in the PKard Factory. .... You probably remember better than I do something of the sensation throughout, when Carson Stone as Head Inspecter of Amunition Department for that company, condemned a whole train-load of amunition just-about to be started for over-seas. Following that and such interference on Stone's part, drew all-kind of threatening letters to him which he seemed to pay little attention to
